title: Electric Service by Rate Schedule Repeat Reconnection Surcharge
content:
**Surcharge table.** A reconnection of an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account after a nonpayment disconnection adds a repeat reconnection surcharge to the reconnect fee when earlier reconnect fees are dated in the account's reconnection look-back:

| Reconnect fees already on the service account dated in the reconnection look-back | Surcharge added to the reconnect fee |
|---|---|
| Two or more | $50.00 |
| Exactly one | $25.00 |
| None | Nothing |

The surcharge is added to the crew charge in the reconnect fee, and the total is rounded to the cent.

### Hypothetical cases

| Earlier reconnect fees in the look-back | Crew charge | Reconnect fee |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | $75.00 | $75.00 |
| 1 | $75.00 | $100.00 |
| 2 | $110.00 | $160.00 |
| 5 | $25.00 | $75.00 |

### Points of reading

- The count is of reconnect fee lines on the same service account, dated in its reconnection look-back, before the reconnection being billed.
- The surcharge does not climb beyond $50.00 however many reconnect fees are counted.
